children: Robert K. Steel, a Director, reported four sales of General Dynamics common stock on 2026-09-23. The transactions totaled 7,440 shares at prices ranging from $345.824 to $346.119, for a weighted average price of approximately $345.98 per share. The total sale amount was $2,574,619. After the reported transactions, Steel directly owned 3,096 shares of General Dynamics. Sale prices ranged from $345.97 to $346.01 and the reporting person will provide, upon request by the Commission staff, General Dynamics, or a General Dynamics shareholder, full information regarding the number of shares sold at each separate sales price.
